verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing has a first-party prorations doc and supports previewing a proration amount before applying a subscription change. That confirms the core mid-cycle proration capability. The pack does not show the proration math, how credits and partial periods are itemized, or that invoice line items reconcile exactly. missing for 10: documented credit/partial-period calculation details, invoice line-item breakdown for prorations, evidence of penny-level reconciliation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, mid-cycle upgrades and downgrades are prorated with documented, auditable math — credits, partial periods, and invoice line items that reconcile to the penny

citations.quote: You can preview a proration to view the amount before applying the changes.
